text:
Maya CS: Quick pre-renewal healthcheck for Verdant Health — renewal call next Tue. Need a consolidated SLO evidence pack (90/30/7d uptime, p50/p95 latency), incident summary, and a credit calc template for finance. Can SRE pull the export?

Ethan SRE: On it. I'll run the SLO export and attach results. ETA EOD today. Will include 90/30/7 day windows.

Maya CS: Thanks. Also need onboarding artifacts: runbook handed to customer, enablement slides, recordings, and a list of outstanding training sessions.

Priya Onboard: I have the onboarding checklist and recordings. Will export links + attendance CSV. Any particular format you need?

Maya CS: CSV + one-pager summary for execs. Also a pre-filled credit calculation template we can drop into the customer email.

Jordan Sales: I can review the credit calc. FYI Verdant flagged renewal risk if downtime >0.5% in last quarter.

Ethan SRE: quick snapshot:

```
90d uptime: 99.93%
30d uptime: 99.98%
p50 gen latency: 120ms
p95 gen latency: 420ms
incidents last 90d: 1 (partial regional outage, 18m)
```

Ethan SRE: I'll open a ticket with logs + KPI export. ticket: CS-4521

incidents-bot: Created ticket CS-4521 for SLO export (link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/CS-4521)

Maya CS: Perfect. Priya, can you add the enablement slide deck and annotate which modules Verdant skipped?

Priya Onboard: Noted. They skipped "prompt engineering clinic" and one ops walkthrough on 2026-02-14. I'll add notes + attendance.

Liam Product: Heads up — that regional outage was tied to a model-variant fallback we rolled out in Jan. We have a short postmortem PR ready; can include a customer-friendly blurb.

Olga Legal: For credits, make sure we follow the contract's 30-day lookback math. I'll review the calc before outreach.

Nora CS: I'll draft the one-page executive summary and the customer-facing email. Will call out uptime, p95 latency, incident summary, and proposed credit if eligible. Will loop Jordan for approval.

Maya CS: Timeline: compile artifacts by tomorrow 3pm PT, internal review by 5pm, customer email sent Tue AM. Is that realistic?

Ethan SRE: Yes, SLO export + ticket by 4pm. Will ping if blockers.

Priya Onboard: Recordings + attendance CSV by 2pm.

Jordan Sales: I'll review credit calc by 4:30pm.

Olga Legal: Review by 5pm.

Nora CS: Draft ready for review by 4:45pm.

Maya CS: Thanks team :thumbsup: — tagging account lead when we send. Jordan, any notes for Sam?

Jordan Sales: Sam usually wants a short summary + proposed remediation steps. Keep it <1 page.

Maya CS: Noted. Adding recommended next enablement session slots to the pack.

Ethan SRE: FYI export command I ran:

```
redwood-slo export --team verdant --window 90d --format csv > verdant_slo_90d.csv
```

Maya CS: Awesome — putting the pack together now. Will post the assembled thread + attachments when ready.

(End of thread)
